name: unizo-ctem
description: Unizo CTEM toolkit for Claude Code: commands, skills, and agents for Continuous Threat Exposure Management workflows.

api_url.title: CTEM API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of your organization's Unizo CTEM gateway, e.g. https://ctem.acme.com. Leave empty if you switch environments with /unizo-ctem:unizo-ctem-env; an active environment replaces these options.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Static bearer token for the gateway, e.g. for a service account. Leave empty to sign in with SSO. If set, it takes precedence over SSO.

sso_issuer.title: SSO issuer URL
sso_issuer.description: OIDC issuer of your identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Auth0, Google Workspace, AWS Cognito, ...). Leave empty if you use an API token.

sso_client_id.title: SSO client ID
sso_client_id.description: Client ID of the native/public app registered for the CTEM plugin in your identity provider.

sso_client_secret.title: SSO client secret
sso_client_secret.description: Only if your identity provider requires a secret for native apps. Prefer a public client with PKCE.

sso_scopes.title: SSO scopes
sso_scopes.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes. offline_access lets the plugin refresh your session without signing in again.

sso_audience.title: SSO audience
sso_audience.description: Sent as the 'audience' parameter. Needed by Auth0 and some Okta authorization servers.

sso_token_type.title: Token sent to the gateway
sso_token_type.description: Which SSO token the gateway expects: 'access' or 'id'.

sso_redirect_port.title: SSO callback port
sso_redirect_port.description: Local port for the sign-in callback. Register http://localhost:<port>/callback as a redirect URI.
